scenes.heading: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY

lines.text: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY
Jake lowers his trembling gun slightly as Harper stares directly into his eyes with fierce resolve.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Jake, your mother Diane poisoned Evelyn just to steal the Whitmore shipping empire!
Cole struggles against his handcuffs, fighting through his recent injuries to protect his wife Harper.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Jake, open your eyes, Diane is using you as a pawn to destroy everything I built!

scenes.heading: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY

lines.text: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY
Diane shrieks in absolute panic as her son Jake turns his gaze from Harper toward her.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Jake, your half-brother Cole is lying to you, shoot her right now before we lose everything!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Choose right now, Jake: run away with a murderer's son, or save what is left of your soul.
Jake's finger twitches nervously on the trigger as he looks back and forth between Diane and Harper.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: If I let you go with Cole, my mother goes to prison for murder.
Suddenly, the front doors crash open and federal agents flood the grand foyer with weapons drawn.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Kill them all, Jake, kill them all right now!
Jake raises his gun directly at Harper's chest with a tear streaming down his face.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: I'm sorry, Harper, but I can't let my mother die.
Jake fires his weapon point-blank into Harper's chest as Cole screams in absolute horror.
